recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-3714 unless a future Patient Care decision changes Procedure.performer.actor target profiles.
issue_request: FHIR-3714 was a Published FHIR-core Procedure issue, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking whether Procedure can represent procedures patients perform themselves and concluding that Procedure.performer should be expanded to allow Patient and RelatedPerson performers.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in historical SVN revision 4379, migrated as git commit 5eed76a7662fea3230578b81d9edff1be6205a61, which changed the Procedure spreadsheet performer type from Reference(Practitioner) to Reference(Practitioner|Patient|RelatedPerson).
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative Procedure StructureDefinition includes Patient and RelatedPerson in Procedure.performer.actor, leaves Procedure.encounter optional, and has a separate optional Procedure.location. Later FHIR-32507 constrained Procedure.performer.onBehalfOf for Practitioner and PractitionerRole but retained Patient and RelatedPerson as allowed actor types. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-3714 evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already satisfies the requested semantics for patient-performed and caregiver-performed procedures, including use outside an encounter.

related_jiras.note: Later Procedure performer/onBehalfOf decision confirms Patient and RelatedPerson remain actor types while restricting onBehalfOf for Practitioner and PractitionerRole.
